headline: Pezeshkian cabinet orders full-readiness implementation

sources: IRNA reporting of Khamenei-Rezaei meeting, via Press TV; President Pezeshkian cabinet remarks via IRNA/Press TV; ANI syndication (Republic/Kalinga/Lokmat/New Kerala/Devdiscourse carries)
fault_line: Deal or decision for war? Does 'end neither war nor peace' mean Tehran is clearing the way to accept a deal before Nov 3, or clearing the way to fight once the midterms pass?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM for cabinet action; ATTRIBUTED REPORT for Khamenei directive] Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei, in a meeting with SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei, directed efforts to end the 'neither war nor peace' / 'no war, no peace' status quo by fulfilling Tehran's announced conditions for ending the war. President Masoud Pezeshkian told the Oct 28 cabinet the directive is 'an important direction' and ordered all ministers/deputies to maintain full readiness, cut costs, raise productivity and national power, and prepare for emerging scenarios; Araghchi briefed the cabinet on Qatari and Pakistani delegation visits. Per IRNA via Morningstar, one reported condition clause is 'safeguarding national and regional security by maintaining control over the Strait of Hormuz'; the word 'nuclear' does not appear in IRNA's reported account. No US acceptance of any Iranian condition is reported.
sections.what_verified: 2 declared families: IRNA/Press TV T3 state-flag IR (primary reporting of both the Khamenei meeting and the cabinet session) + ANI T1 (syndicated carry of the cabinet implementation). Morningstar/MarketWatch is NOT in the source registry and counts for context only, not corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: Morningstar explicitly notes it is 'not even clear that Mojtaba Khamenei is alive' to the outside world and that no direct transcript is public -- the directive reaches us only through Iranian state reporting. The Hormuz-control condition, if literal, conflicts with the US escort/blockade posture and with Washington's demand that nuclear talks come first (Axios via prior scans). Pezeshkian's readiness order cuts both ways: it signals deal-seeking AND war preparation.
sections.why_matters: Tehran's top order, in one line: end the limbo. Pair Khamenei's directive with Pezeshkian's full-readiness order and the Hormuz-control clause -- then ask which side of the Nov 3 line it points to.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (cabinet Wed Oct 28, ANI carry Thu Oct 29, in no prior Oct 29 scan as a standalone item) -- Khamenei directs end to 'neither war nor peace'; Pezeshkian cabinet orders full-readiness implementation

totw_analysis: Our read: Tehran's top order, in one line: end the limbo. Pair Khamenei's directive with Pezeshkian's full-readiness order and the Hormuz-control clause -- then ask which side of the Nov 3 line it points to. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deal or decision for war? Does 'end neither war nor peace' mean Tehran is clearing the way to accept a deal before Nov 3, or clearing the way to fight once the midterms pass?
